title: The Case of the Missing Idea
slogan: AI NEWS · HUMAN-CENTRED · HUMANS IN CONTROL
music: Urban lo-fi hip hop beat with a noir edge: dusty boom-bap drums, deep bass, muted jazz piano chords, vinyl crackle, thoughtful, no vocals.
ambience: City rooftop at dusk, distant traffic, a far siren, wind, pigeons, no music.

sources.name: MIT Media Lab, Your Brain on ChatGPT (2025 preprint)

shots.say: Case four starts with a question. If a machine can write anything, what is left for you?

sfx.prompt: Spray paint can shaking with the rattle ball, then a long spray hiss on a wall

shots.say: Twenty-four centuries ago, Socrates had the same fear. In Plato's Phaedrus, writing is blamed for making people forgetful, and wise only in appearance.

ov.text: “They will appear wise, without being wise.”
ov.by: Plato, Phaedrus (paraphrased) · on the invention of writing

sfx.prompt: Warm Mediterranean wind over stone ruins, cicadas far away

shots.say: In twenty twenty-five, MIT researchers asked fifty-four people to write essays. One group used ChatGPT. One used a search engine. One used only their brains.

sfx.prompt: Soft electronic beeps of brain monitoring equipment in a lab

shots.say: The ChatGPT group showed the lowest brain engagement, and struggled to recall what they had written. It's a small study, not yet peer reviewed. But the question stands.

sfx.prompt: Soft electric power down hum fading out

shots.say: Writing, search, AI. The tools keep changing. What never moved is where ideas come from: a person asking a question nobody asked before.

ov.sub: the question is the part you bring

sfx.prompt: Old filament light bulb switching on with a warm electric buzz

shots.say: So use the machine. Let it draft, search, check. But bring your own idea. Case closed.

sfx.prompt: Single heavy rubber stamp thud on paper on a wooden desk
